# benchmark-skateboard

> Deterministic physical-reasoning benchmark for 12 skateboard tricks across Earth, Moon, and Mars conditions.

Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/benchmark-skateboard
Repository: https://github.com/pooriaarab/benchmark-skateboard
Directory: https://aibenchmarkindex.com/benchmarks/benchmark-skateboard

## Measure

Version 0.2.0. The 36 single-answer tasks check signed rotations on three axes, projectile airtime and peak height, wheels-down orientation, and whether a trick fits its declared minimum airtime. Answers are JSON (one optional Markdown fence or preamble). Numeric values have a 5% relative tolerance; rotations must match together before landing booleans count.

## Data

`data/tricks.json` is a human-written CC0 glossary with public reference links. `scripts/gen-tasks.mjs` reproducibly generates the MIT-licensed task grid. Public seed: 20261015. `data/PROVENANCE.md` contains retrieval, contamination, hidden-split, and refresh details.

## Exports and commands

The root exports `benchmark`, `run`, and `score`. `benchmark-skateboard/api` exports the fetch-style handler. `benchmark-skateboard/mcp` exports MCP builders.

The CLI supports `list`, `show`, `run`, `score`, `card`, `provenance`, `index-entry`, `serve`, and `mcp`. Run offline with `npx benchmark-skateboard run --provider mock`.

## Documentation

- README.md: quick start and all four surfaces
- docs/grading.md: weights, checks, and anticipated failures
- docs/methodology.md: axes, equations, assumptions, and limits
- artifacts/e2e-report.json: generated verification record
